historical_record.description: A single-family dwelling stood at the rear of the lot.

The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved, with modifications, the construction of a new three-story dwelling at the front of a lot where a single-family dwelling exists at the rear, removing the top floor of the proposed house in part.
